title: Long-time $L^2$&$H^1$-stability of the Family of DLN Methods for the Two-dimensional Incompressible Navier-Stokes Equations
summary: In this report, we study the long-time stability of the family of one-leg DLN methods for the two-dimensional incompressible Navier-Stokes equations. The family of DLN methods (with one parameter $θ$), non-linear energy stable ($G$-stable) and second-order accurate under arbitrary time grids, has been widely applied to the simulations of various fluid models with success. We derive a new version of the $G$-stability identity for the family of DLN methods under uniform time grids and mild time constraints.
